end_chip.basis: R2: median over vendor groups of each group's median plunge chip per tooth h_p/D (stated plunge fz, or the vendor's plunge/drilling factor × its slot fz), per diameter band, ≥ 2 groups (neighbouring bands pooled when fewer)

ramp_end_chip_reported.basis: vendor ramp chip × sin(maximum ramp angle) ('stated' and 'rule' rows); reported, not a constraint

consensus.basis: Vendor ramp guardrail (owner decisions 2026-11-12/13, as C14): ramp angle ≤ the vendor's published range at the aggressiveness (0 % bottom, 50 % middle, 100 % top), from the tool's brand, else Harvey + Helical, else the cross-vendor consensus, using rows whose tool has no more flutes and no longer reach; a published maximum only: bottom from the fitted bottom/top ratio; larger-tool rows only or no covering row: the bottom. Plunge feed ≤ scale × median plunge/slot feed factor × the ramp (slot-like) feed (data/model_v2/ramp.json)

angle.basis: Vendor ramp guardrail (owner decisions 2026-11-12/13, as C14): ramp angle ≤ the vendor's published range at the aggressiveness (0 % bottom, 50 % middle, 100 % top), from the tool's brand, else Harvey + Helical, else the cross-vendor consensus, using rows whose tool has no more flutes and no longer reach; a published maximum only: bottom from the fitted bottom/top ratio; larger-tool rows only or no covering row: the bottom. Plunge feed ≤ scale × median plunge/slot feed factor × the ramp (slot-like) feed (data/model_v2/ramp.json)

max_only_rule.text: bottom = 0.50 × the published maximum (median over 3 vendor groups of each group's median bottom/top ratio, 83 rows that publish a range), middle = halfway between bottom and top, as for a published range; a single published angle counts as the maximum
